# hpe_morpheus_network_router_firewall_rule (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_network_router_firewall_rule" "example" {
  router_id = 1
  name      = "Example Firewall Rule"
  policy    = "accept"
  enabled   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the firewall rule
- `router_id` (Number) The ID of the parent network router

### Optional

- `direction` (String) Direction (ingress or egress)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the firewall rule is enabled
- `policy` (String) Policy action (accept, deny, reject)
- `port_range` (String) Port range
- `priority` (Number) Priority of the firewall rule
- `protocol` (String) Protocol

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the firewall rule

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_network_router_firewall_rule.example 123
```
